content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").1 (Root Element)
content.text: root(e) ≡ layer(e).stratum = purpose ∧ ¬∃d ∈ D. d.tgt.elem = e.id ∧ d.δ = realizes

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").2 (Trace Path)
content.text: tracePath(e) = shortest path from e to some e' where root(e') following realizes dependencies from target to source (impl → requirement)

content.label: GUARANTEE G1 - PROVENANCE
content.formula: ∀ e ∈ E. ∃ e' ∈ E. root(e') ∧ reachable(e, e', realizes)
content.description: Every element traces back to a root element in the purpose stratum (realizes goes impl → requirement)

content.text:
Formally, for specification S:
Provenanced(S) ≡ ∀ e ∈ elements(S). tracePath(e) ≠ ∅

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").3 (Constraint Satisfaction)
content.text: S ⊨ c ≡ c.φ(elements(S), dependencies(S)) = ⊤

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").4 (Error Constraints)
content.text: ErrorConstraints(S) = {c ∈ constraints(S) | c.sev = error}

Formally:
Adequate(S) ≡ ∀ c ∈ ErrorConstraints(S). c.φ(E, D) = ⊤
Common adequacy constraints:

items: ∀ feature f. ∃ test t. tests(t, f) - Feature test coverage
∀ api a. ∃ doc d. documents(d, a) - API documentation
∀ aggregate ag. ∃ command c. commands(ag, c) - Aggregate has commands

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").5 (Contradiction)
content.text:
contradiction(e₁, e₂) ≡ ∃ property p.
  e₁.π(p) is defined ∧ e₂.π(p) is defined ∧
  e₁.π(p) ≠ e₂.π(p) ∧ unifies(e₁, e₂, p)

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").6 (Unifies)
content.text: unifies(e₁, e₂, p) ≡ ∃ c ∈ C. c.cat = non_contradiction ∧ c specifies e₁.p must equal e₂.p

content.label: GUARANTEE G3 - NON-CONTRADICTION
content.description: No two elements have contradictory properties

content.text:
Formally:
NonContradictory(S) ≡ ∀ e₁, e₂ ∈ elements(S). ¬contradiction(e₁, e₂)
Common non-contradiction constraints:

items: API return type = Handler return type
Event schema = Event handler expected schema
Database field type = Domain entity field type

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").7 (Terminal Element)
content.text: terminal(e) ≡ layer(e).stratum = physical

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").8 (Materialized Element)
content.text: materialized(e) ≡ ∃ b ∈ B. b.abstract.elem = e.id

content.label: GUARANTEE G4 - MATERIALIZATION
content.description: Every terminal element has a binding to physical reality

content.text:
Formally:
Materialized(S) ≡ ∀ e ∈ elements(S). terminal(e) → materialized(e)
Materialization types per domain:

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").9 (Change)
content.text: δ ::= ⟨element: ID, changeType: CHANGE, details: VALUE⟩

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").10 (Impact)
content.text: impact(S, δ) = ⋃ {cascade(S, elem(δ), δ.changeType, r) | r ∈ R, r.trigger matches δ}

content.label: GUARANTEE G5 - PREDICTABILITY
content.formula: ∀ δ : CHANGE. impact(S, δ) is computable before applying δ
content.description: The impact of any change is predictable before making the change

content.text:
Formally:
Predictable(S) ≡ impact : S × CHANGE → P(E × EFFECT) is total and computable in O(|E| + |D|) time
This enables:

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").11 (Stratum Respecting)
content.text:
stratumRespecting(d) ≡ let l_s = layer(src(d)), l_t = layer(tgt(d)) in
  rank(l_s) ≥ rank(l_t) ∨ d.δ = realizes

content.label: GUARANTEE G6 - STRATIFICATION
content.description: Dependencies flow from concrete to abstract (except realizes)

content.text:
Formally:
Stratified(S) ≡ ∀ d ∈ dependencies(S). stratumRespecting(d)
This ensures:
Exception: realizes dependencies go UP (from impl to requirement)

When validation fails, humans need actionable explanations. G7 requires that every violation report includes an irreducible unsat core—the minimal set of constraints causing the failure—and human-readable diagnostic text.

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").12 (Diagnosis)
content.text: diagnosis ::= ⟨violatedGuarantee, minimalConflictSet, causalTrace, diagnosticMessage, suggestedFix?⟩
where:

items.definition: Causal chain of changes leading to violation (uses vector clocks from referenceMap("sub-xYOy8xUJpcssgjNVmANNW", "§{{sectionNumber}}.1 Element"), referenceMap("sec-FKg-HIOFmN1Oiyr_KJhnT", "§{{sectionNumber}}"))
Natural language explanation targeting domain experts

content.label: GUARANTEE G7 - EXPLAINABILITY
content.formula: ∀ violations v from validate(S). ∃ diagnosis d. explains(d, v) ∧ irreducible(d.minimalConflictSet)
content.description: Every validation failure has an irreducible diagnosis with minimal conflict set

content.text:
Formally:
Explainable(S) ≡ validate(S) produces diagnoses for all violations
**Implementation**: Use SMT solver unsat core extraction (Z3 `unsat_core()`, CVC5 `getUnsatCore()`). See Theorem 10.12 for irreducibility proof obligation.
**Conformance**: G7 is **K1 (Certified-Aware)**, not K0. K0 implementations may return violations without explanations. K1+ implementations MUST provide irreducible unsat cores per Theorem 10.12.
**Example**: See referenceMap("sub-sec-FKg-HIOFmN1Oiyr_KJhnT-5", "§{{sectionNumber}}.5 How to Read This Document") Demo Scenario for complete G7 workflow showing blame chains and suggested fixes.

content.label: Definition referenceMap("sec-taGb2W-Ks5lKWB8hcj3UY", "§{{sectionNumber}}").13 (Valid Specification)
content.text:
Valid(S) ≡ WellFormed(S) ∧
           Provenanced(S) ∧     -- G1
           Adequate(S) ∧        -- G2
           NonContradictory(S) ∧ -- G3
           Materialized(S) ∧    -- G4
           Predictable(S) ∧     -- G5
           Stratified(S) ∧      -- G6
           Explainable(S)       -- G7
A specification is valid iff it is well-formed and satisfies all seven guarantees. Note: G7 (Explainability) is K1 conformance; K0 implementations check G1-G6 only.
